info.title: MLaaS
info.description:
ML as a Service provided by R&D team of Virtuos.

To obtain a temporary JWT token (Expires every 2 hours), please visit [Token Generator](https://mlaas.virtuosgames.com/auth/token) and use it as HTTPBearer authentication (i.e. as `Authorization` header with a `Bearer` prefix).

To get a long-term API key, please visit [here](https://virtuosgames.freshservice.com/support/catalog/items/302), and use it with APIKeyHeader authentication (i.e. as `x-api-key` header).

Need help? Chat with the [MLAAS API Assistant](/assistant) for guidance on authentication, endpoints, and request formats. (requires API key login)

get.description:
Comprehensive memory snapshot that captures BOTH tracemalloc-tracked
allocations AND untracked C-level memory (PIL pixel buffers, httpx
connection pools, SSL contexts, etc.).

This endpoint is heavier than /debug/memory because it walks the entire
GC heap. Use it when you need to understand the gap between tracemalloc
totals and actual RSS.

GenerationRawOutputs.title: GenerationRawOutputs
GenerationRawOutputs.description:
Like GenerationOutputs but stores images as raw base64 strings.

Use this when images are already base64-encoded (e.g. from OpenRouter/TogetherAI)
to avoid the wasteful PIL decode → re-encode round-trip.

use_line_precision.title: Use Lineart for Precision
use_line_precision.description: Enable if you want to use original image lineart for precision, this may reduce output quality or creative ideation

image_key.description: S3 key for single image (alternative to image). Obtained from the upload-urls endpoint.

multi_view_keys.title: Multi View Keys
multi_view_keys.description: S3 keys for multi-view images, keyed by view name (alternative to multi_view_images). Obtained from the upload-urls endpoint.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The mode to use for the submission, only used for regular model.

result_format.title: Result Format
result_format.description: The format of the result. Regular model only supports OBJ/GLB; rapid and pro also support STL/USDZ/FBX.

enable_geometry.title: Enable Geometry
enable_geometry.description: Enable geometry (untextured white model), only for rapid model

face_count.title: Face Count
face_count.description: The number of faces in the result, only for pro model

generate_type.title: Generate Type
generate_type.description: Generation type, only for pro model

polygon_type.title: Polygon Type
polygon_type.description: Polygon type, only for pro model LowPoly generate type

pro_model_version.title: Pro Model Version
pro_model_version.description: Model version, only for pro model. 3.1 adds top/bottom/left_front/right_front view angles.

Image.title: Image
Image.description: Represents the content or the URL of an image generated by the OpenAI API.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

ImagesResponse.title: ImagesResponse
ImagesResponse.description: The response from the image generation endpoint.

q.title: Q
q.description: Query string to search with. You can use anything thatyou would type into Google Images search.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

context.title: Context
context.description: Context that we want to enhance this prompt for (e.g image generation, report summary etc)

creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.description: Use a value of 100% for allowing fully creativity images, Use 40% to retain base image look.

subscription_key.title: Subscription Key
subscription_key.description: Subscription key returned from job submission.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: List of job statuses and progress details.

task_uuid.title: Task Uuid
task_uuid.description: Task UUID of the completed job to download.

images.title: Images
images.description: Base64-encoded images for Image-to-3D. Max 5 images. First image determines material. Omit for Text-to-3D (requires prompt).

image_keys.title: Image Keys
image_keys.description: S3 keys for images (alternative to images). Ordered list; first key is used for material. Obtained from the upload-urls endpoint.

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: Subscription key for tracking the job.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Job details including task UUIDs and status.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Generation tier. 'Gen-2' uses the new model with better quality. Sketch/Regular/Detail/Smooth are the original tiers.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text guidance for generation. For Text-to-3D (no images): required. For Image-to-3D: optional; if omitted, the API auto-generates a prompt from the images.

use_original_alpha.title: Use Original Alpha
use_original_alpha.description: Preserve image transparency channel. Default false.

condition_mode.title: Condition Mode
condition_mode.description: Multi-image processing approach. Not supported by Gen-2. Default concat.

mesh_simplify.title: Mesh Simplify
mesh_simplify.description: Enable mesh simplification. Raw mode only. Default true. Not supported by Gen-2.

mesh_smooth.title: Mesh Smooth
mesh_smooth.description: Enable mesh smoothing. Quad mode only. Default true (service default). Not supported by Gen-2.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Mesh face count preset: high (50k), medium (18k), low (8k), extra-low (4k).

quality_override.title: Quality Override
quality_override.description: Custom polygon count, overrides quality preset. Old API: 2000-200000. Gen-2 Raw: 500-1M; Gen-2 Quad: 1k-200k.

material.title: Material
material.description: Material type for textures: PBR, Shaded, or All.

addons.title: Addons
addons.description: Premium features. Supported value: 'HighPack' (4K textures, higher face count).

TAPose.title: Tapose
TAPose.description: Force T/A pose for human models.

bbox_condition.title: Bbox Condition
bbox_condition.description: Max bounding box [Width(Y), Height(Z), Length(X)] in user-defined units.

preview_render.title: Preview Render
preview_render.description: Generate a high-quality preview render image. Default false.

use_hyper.title: Use Hyper
use_hyper.description: Legacy field from earlier API versions. Kept for backward compatibility.

creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.description: Use a value of 100% for allowing fully creativity images, Use <86% to retain base image look.

upscaleby.title: UpscaleBy
upscaleby.description: 0 will disable 2nd pass refinement, value higher than 2 will lead to slower output and more memory usage.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Tripo task ID to check status for.

output.title: Output
output.description: Task output data (model URLs, renders, etc.).

original_model_task_id.title: Original Model Task Id
original_model_task_id.description: Task ID of the model to complete.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Model version. P1-20260311 is optimized for low-poly and rejects unsupported params. Turbo-v1.0-20250506 is image/text only. v3.0+ adds geometry_quality. Default: v2.5-20250123.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text input for text_to_model. Max 1024 characters (~100 words). No emojis or special Unicode.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Reverse prompt to contrast with the main prompt. text_to_model only. Max 255 characters.

file.title: File
file.description: Source image for image_to_model. Suggested resolution > 256x256px. Provide file_token, url, or object.

files.title: Files
files.description: Source images for multiview_to_model. Must be exactly 4 items [front, left, back, right]. Front cannot be omitted. Provide {} to skip a view. Suggested resolution > 256x256px.

texture_alignment.title: Texture Alignment
texture_alignment.description: Texture alignment priority: 'original_image' (visual fidelity) or 'geometry' (3D accuracy). API default is original_image; this service defaults to geometry.

quad.title: Quad
quad.description: Enable quad mesh output. Forces FBX format. Default face_limit becomes 10000 when enabled. Not supported by P1-20260311. v2.0+. Default None (Tripo treats absent as false).

face_limit.title: Face Limit
face_limit.description: Max faces on output model. Adaptive if not set. smart_low_poly range: 1000-20000; with quad: 500-10000; P1 range: 48-20000.

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: Enable texturing. API default true. Set false for an untextured base model. v2.0+.

pbr.title: Pbr
pbr.description: Enable PBR materials. API default true. Forces texture=true when enabled. v2.0+.

texture_seed.title: Texture Seed
texture_seed.description: Random seed for texture generation. Same seed produces identical textures. v2.0+.

model_seed.title: Model Seed
model_seed.description: Random seed for geometry generation. Same seed produces identical geometry. v2.0+.

auto_size.title: Auto Size
auto_size.description: Scale model to real-world dimensions (meters). API default false. v2.0+.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Set to 'align_image' to auto-rotate model to align original image. API default 'default'. v2.0+.

compress.title: Compress
compress.description: Output compression: 'geometry' applies meshopt compression. Requires decompression for most editors. v2.0+.

smart_low_poly.title: Smart Low Poly
smart_low_poly.description: Generate low-poly mesh with hand-crafted topology. API default false. face_limit range: 1000-20000. Not supported by P1-20260311. v2.0+.

generate_parts.title: Generate Parts
generate_parts.description: Generate segmented model with editable parts. API default false. Incompatible with texture=true, pbr=true, or quad=true. Not supported by P1-20260311. v2.0+.

export_uv.title: Export Uv
export_uv.description: Perform UV unwrapping during generation. API default true. Set false for faster generation; UV handled during texturing stage. v2.0+.

enable_image_autofix.title: Enable Image Autofix
enable_image_autofix.description: Optimize input image for better generation result. API default false. image_to_model only.

geometry_quality.title: Geometry Quality
geometry_quality.description: 'detailed' (ultra mode, max detail) or 'standard' (balanced). v3.0+ only; not supported by P1-20260311.

image_seed.title: Image Seed
image_seed.description: Random seed for the prompt-to-image step. text_to_model only.

image_key.title: Image Key
image_key.description: S3 key for single image (alternative to file). Obtained from the upload-urls endpoint.

image_keys.title: Image Keys
image_keys.description: S3 keys for multi-view images keyed by view name (alternative to files). Obtained from the upload-urls endpoint.

original_model_task_id.title: Original Model Task Id
original_model_task_id.description: Task ID of the model to segment.

data.title: Data
data.description: Tripo API response payload containing task details.

file.title: File
file.description: Base64-encoded file data to upload to Tripo.

key.title: Key
key.description: S3 object key. Pass this to the submit endpoint.

put_url.title: Put Url
put_url.description: Presigned PUT URL. HTTP PUT your file here.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: Upload slots keyed by label (with suffix if repeated).

UsageInputTokensDetails.title: UsageInputTokensDetails
UsageInputTokensDetails.description: The input tokens detailed information for the image generation.

UsageOutputTokensDetails.title: UsageOutputTokensDetails
UsageOutputTokensDetails.description: The output token details for the image generation.

files.title: Files
files.description: Labels for files to upload. Allowed labels: image, front, back, left, right, top, bottom, left_front, right_front, mesh. Views cannot repeat; 'image' and 'mesh' can.

openai__types__create_embedding_response.title: Usage
openai__types__create_embedding_response.description: The usage information for the request.

openai__types__images_response__Usage.title: Usage
openai__types__images_response__Usage.description: For `gpt-image-1` only, the token usage information for the image generation.
